title: Kubernetes API Priority and Fairness：座位預算與請求成本
titleEn: Kubernetes API Priority and Fairness: seat budgets and request cost
subcategoryTitle: 多租戶、復原相依與可用性邊界
subcategoryTitleEn: Multitenancy, recovery dependencies and availability boundaries
summary: 用合成座位預算比較兩個優先等級，保留請求成本與占用時間；建立明確簡化模型，不宣稱重現Kubernetes完整排程演算法。
summaryEn: Compare two priority levels using a synthetic seat budget, preserving request cost and occupancy duration. State the simplified model explicitly rather than claiming to reproduce the complete Kubernetes scheduling algorithm.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

stages.title: 固定優先等級與簡化假設
stages.description: 控制平面演練把每個請求都算一個同成本工作，忽略不同請求可能占用不同座位；租戶大量請求使低成本健康查詢也被排隊。 用合成座位預算比較兩個優先等級，保留請求成本與占用時間；建立明確簡化模型，不宣稱重現Kubernetes完整排程演算法。 將上述邊界、欄位與負責角色畫成一頁輸入到輸出的證據圖，對照來源文件定位需要保留的語意。 每個請求保留flow_key、priority_level、seat_cost、arrival及release時間。檢查重疊時段occupied_seats而非一天內累計座位；釋放座位後新請求才可進入，座位時間與座位瞬時數需分開量測。
stages.descriptionEn: A control-plane exercise counts every request as equal-cost work, ignoring that requests can occupy different numbers of seats. A noisy tenant causes lightweight health queries to queue behind expensive work. Compare two priority levels using a synthetic seat budget, preserving request cost and occupancy duration. State the simplified model explicitly rather than claiming to reproduce the complete Kubernetes scheduling algorithm. Draw a one-page evidence map from those inputs to outputs, identify the responsible roles, and locate the corresponding semantic contract in the cited project documentation. For each request record flow_key, priority_level, seat_cost, arrival and release time. Check occupied seats during overlapping intervals rather than summing a whole day. Admit new work after seats are released, and keep seat-time consumption distinct from the instantaneous number of occupied seats when comparing workloads.
